knowledge:
- key_parameters: SampleSheet=A data-frame or matrix containing sample metadata. It must have a column named "SampleName" with unique sample IDs ;; FileSheet=A data-frame or matrix containing file paths. It must have columns named "SampleName", "bam", "bigwig", and "interval" ;; igvdirectory=The directory where the IGV session XML and metadata files will be written ;; basedirectory=The directory where the HTML report and associated files will be written ;; genome=The genome assembly to be used in IGV (e.g., "mm9") ;; colourBy=A character string specifying the metadata column in SampleSheet used to color tracks in IGV ;; igvParam=An igvParams class object defining display settings like scale and limits for tracks
- alternatives: None mentioned in the documentation
- when_to_use: Use this package when you have large cohorts of genomics data (such as ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, or genomic intervals) and want to generate portable, interactive HTML reports and pre-configured IGV sessions to share with collaborators or use for quality control.
- pitfalls: Both SampleSheet and FileSheet must contain a "SampleName" column with matching unique IDs; samples not present in both will be excluded. Missing files in the FileSheet must be represented as NA values rather than being omitted. It is highly recommended to create reports in a new directory alongside the data files to maintain relative paths and ensure the HTML report is portable.

workflows.name: igv_session_and_html_report_generation
workflows.intent: Generate IGV session XML files and interactive HTML tracktable reports from genomics file paths and sample metadata.
input: SampleSheet (matrix/data-frame containing "SampleName" and metadata columns like "Antibody" and "Species")
workflows.stages: 1. Prepare the FileSheet and SampleSheet matrices ;; 2. Generate the IGV session XML and metadata file using MakeIGVSession() ;; 3. Define custom IGV display parameters using igvParam() ;; 4. Generate the interactive HTML report using maketracktable()
workflows.code:
library(tracktables)

fileLocations <- system.file("extdata",package="tracktables")

bigwigs <- dir(fileLocations,pattern="*.bw",full.names=TRUE)
intervals <- dir(fileLocations,pattern="*.bed",full.names=TRUE)
bigWigMat <- cbind(gsub("_Example.bw","",basename(bigwigs)),
                   bigwigs)
intervalsMat <- cbind(gsub("_Peaks.bed","",basename(intervals)),
                      intervals)

FileSheet <- merge(bigWigMat,intervalsMat,all=TRUE)
FileSheet <- as.matrix(cbind(FileSheet,NA))
colnames(FileSheet) <- c("SampleName","bigwig","interval","bam")

SampleSheet <- cbind(as.vector(FileSheet[,"SampleName"]),
                     c("EBF","H3K4me3","H3K9ac","RNAPol2"),
                     c("ProB","ProB","ProB","ProB"))
colnames(SampleSheet) <- c("SampleName","Antibody","Species")

MakeIGVSession(SampleSheet,FileSheet,igvdirectory=getwd(),"Example","mm9")

HTMLreport <- maketracktable(fileSheet=FileSheet,
                             SampleSheet=SampleSheet,
                             filename="IGVExample.html",
                             basedirectory=getwd(),
                             genome="mm9")

igvDisplayParams <- igvParam(bigwig.autoScale = "false",
                             bigwig.minimum = 1,
                             bigwig.maximum = 5)

HTMLreport <- maketracktable(FileSheet,SampleSheet,"IGVex2.html",getwd(),"mm9",
                             colourBy="Antibody",
                             igvParam=igvDisplayParams)
